requirement: Help in the chat: suggestions leave at the next message, a bare /help after the chat began asks back, one orange button stops Help first and the agent second, /help is a claimed token (answers carry a rating again since PR #1188)

oracle.ref: PR #1138 (fix); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/help-in-chat-2026-10-11/ (before/after screenshots on a real dsh page, measures in after-measures.txt)
oracle.invariant: S1: the suggestions row is removed; only the question row stays. S2: two askBack rows (the person's /help and one sentence), no suggestions row, no request. S3: streamingRowOf names the row while it streams and nothing after stop; the answer row is 'stopped' with the text that arrived; the waiting questions are 'stopped' and never sent; a later question is sent. S4: every source test passes (the row has no stop button; since PR #1188 a finished answer carries dsh's action row, REG-PR-1188-answer-actions). S5: since PR #1188 the answer id and rating come back on a restore and from the done event; a press posts POST /api/assistant/turns/:id/rating (REG-PR-1188-answer-actions). S6: hover/press use --dsw-alias-button-primary-hover (darker terracotta), no blue info hover; focus is a 1px --ring outline with no box-shadow.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
